description_for_human: Context-aware dream interpretation and structured dream parsing for journals, sleep products, publications, research tools, communities, and AI agents.
description_for_model: Use DreamThreads to generate a tentative, context-aware reflection from dream text or parse a dream into structured entities, emotions, actions, agency, threat, outcome, and recurrence. Never present the output as diagnosis, prediction, or fixed truth. Preserve uncertainty and returned attribution.
